license_required.quote: Whoever, not being licensed or otherwise authorized according to the law of this state, shall advertise oneself as practicing medicine, or shall practice medicine, according to the meaning of RSA 329, or in any way hold oneself out as qualified so to do, or call oneself a "physician," ... is engaged in unlawful practice.

interval_years.quote: The board shall require each licensee to show proof at least at every biennial license renewal that the licensee has completed 100 hours of approved continuing medical education program within the preceding 2 years.

available.quote: All boards or commissions shall grant a license to an individual certified or licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for certification or licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established in New Hampshire.
available.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 332-G - General Administration of Regulatory Boards ] Section 332-G:12 - Reciprocity Information.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current and valid license in another state with requirements equivalent to or greater than New Hampshire's. The board may also issue courtesy licenses (not exceeding 100 days) to holders of active licenses in good standing from jurisdictions with substantially similar requirements.
requirements.quote: All applicants shall hold an active license in good standing from another jurisdiction that has substantially similar licensing requirements to New Hampshire's licensing requirements.

national_certification.quote: The office shall waive the examination requirement for any applicant who has satisfactorily passed all examinations and requirements to become board certified by the American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) or by the American Osteopathic Association (AOA).

credential_type.quote: The office shall grant an unrestricted permanent license to persons it finds to have the necessary professional qualifications.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing false information during any application for professional licensure or hospital privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly provided false information during any application for professional licensure or hospital privileges, whether by making any affirmative statement which was false at the time it was made or by failing to disclose any fact material to the application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being a habitual user of drugs or intoxicants
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a habitual user of drugs or intoxicants.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Displaying medical practice incompatible with basic knowledge and competence expected of licensed physicians
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has displayed medical practice which is incompatible with the basic knowledge and competence expected of persons licensed to practice medicine or any particular aspect or specialty thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonest or unprofessional conduct, gross or repeated negligence, or intentionally injuring a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in dishonest or unprofessional conduct or has been grossly or repeatedly negligent in practicing medicine or in performing activities ancillary to the practice of medicine or any particular aspect or specialty thereof, or has intentionally injured a patient while practicing medicine or performing such ancillary activities.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or allowing an unlicensed person to practice in the licensee's office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed or allowed an unlicensed person to practice in the licensee's office.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide adequate safeguards regarding aseptic or radiation techniques
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to provide adequate safeguards in regard to aseptic techniques or radiation techniques.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Including in advertising any statement tending to deceive or mislead the public or claiming professional superiority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has included in advertising any statement of a character tending to deceive or mislead the public or any statement claiming professional superiority.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the use of any drug or medicine of an unknown formula or unnamed/misrepresented anesthetic system
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has advertised the use of any drug or medicine of an unknown formula or any system of anesthetic that is unnamed, misnamed, misrepresented, or not in reality used.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violating any provision of this chapter or any substantive rule of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully or repeatedly violated any provision of this chapter or any substantive rule of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under the laws of the United States or any state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony under the laws of the United States or any state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain adequate medical record documentation or unreasonably delaying medical record transfer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to maintain adequate medical record documentation on diagnostic and therapeutic treatment provided or has unreasonably delayed medical record transfer, or violated RSA 332-I.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly obtaining or assisting in obtaining a controlled substance prescription without a valid physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly obtained, attempted to obtain or assisted a person in obtaining or attempting to obtain a prescription for a controlled substance without having formed a valid physician-patient relationship pursuant to RSA 329:1-c.

definition_quote.value: Any person shall be regarded as practicing medicine under the meaning of this chapter who shall diagnose, treat, perform surgery, or prescribe any treatment of medicine for any disease or human ailment.
definition_quote.quote: Any person shall be regarded as practicing medicine under the meaning of this chapter who shall diagnose, treat, perform surgery, or prescribe any treatment of medicine for any disease or human ailment.

methods_authorized.quote: who shall diagnose, treat, perform surgery, or prescribe any treatment of medicine for any disease or human ailment

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe drugs including controlled substances (schedules II-IV) via telemedicine; may prescribe for off-label indications; prescribing without a valid physician-patient relationship is unprofessional conduct subject to discipline.
drug_authority.quote: A physician licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine.

license_status_types.quote: The office may issue special licenses containing conditions, limitations, or restrictions ... The office may issue courtesy licenses ... The office may issue licenses authorizing the practice of medicine limited to administrative medicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must have studied at a medical school recognized by the United Nations World Health Organization (UNWHO) and have their studies confirmed by Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) Certification.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: has studied medicine in a medical school located outside the United States which is recognized by the United Nations World Health Organization (UNWHO) and had such studies confirmed by Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) Certification

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed at least 2 years of postgraduate training approved by the Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education, or its equivalent as determined by the board.

pain_management_education_required.quote: Procedures for appropriate pain management pursuant to RSA 318-B:10, IX.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: When prescribing opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine, a subsequent evaluation shall be conducted at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: When prescribing a non-opioid or opioid controlled drug classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine a subsequent evaluation shall be conducted by a practitioner licensed to prescribe the drug at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine. A subsequent evaluation shall be conducted at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually. All prescribing shall be in compliance with all federal and state laws and regulations.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine. When prescribing a non-opioid or opioid controlled drug classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine a subsequent evaluation shall be conducted by a practitioner licensed to prescribe the drug at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: An out-of-state physician providing services by means of telemedicine shall be deemed to be in the practice of medicine and shall be required to be licensed under this chapter.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: the member states of the interstate medical licensure compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards and provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple states

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every insurer, including self-insurers, providing professional liability insurance to a licensee of the board shall send a complete report to the board as to all reservable claims coincident with medical injury that take place in this state or in any other state within 30 days after establishing the reserve.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Every facility administrator, or designee, for any licensed hospital, health clinic, ambulatory surgical center, or other health care facility within the state shall report to the office any disciplinary or adverse action, within 30 days after such action is taken

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The office of professional licensure and certification may contract with other organizations to operate the professionals' health program for physicians and physician associates who are impaired or potentially impaired because of mental or physical illness including substance abuse or disruptive behavior.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The board may take non-disciplinary remedial action against any person licensed by it upon finding that the person is afflicted with physical or mental disability, disease, disorder, or condition deemed dangerous to the public health.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The office may issue licenses authorizing the practice of medicine limited to administrative medicine for physicians whose practice does not include the provision of clinical services to patients.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The office may issue courtesy licenses authorizing the practice of medicine under limited conditions as defined by the board by rule. Courtesy licenses shall not exceed 100 days and shall be limited in location.

scope__license_status_types.quote: A licensee who does not intend to engage in such licensed profession in this state, upon written request to the office of professional licensure and certification, may have one's name transferred to inactive status

The office may also, in consultation with the board, by consent or after notice and the opportunity to be heard, resolve issues concerning professional qualifications or circumstances that would be grounds for non-disciplinary remedial action against a licensed physician by granting a temporary license

The office may issue special licenses containing conditions, limitations, or restrictions, including licenses limited to specific periods of time in accordance with rules adopted under RSA 329:9, VIII.
By suspension, limitation, or restriction of a license for a period of time as determined reasonable by the board.
The procedural and substantive requirements for the reinstatement of licenses after lapses, inactive status, voluntary surrender, or disciplinary action consistent with this chapter.
"Expedited license" means a full and unrestricted medical license granted by a member state to an eligible physician through the process set forth in the compact.

The office shall issue special training licenses to persons of good professional character who are enrolled in a regular residency or graduate fellowship training program accredited by the Council on Graduate Medical Education

The office may issue courtesy licenses authorizing the practice of medicine under limited conditions as defined by the board by rule. Courtesy licenses shall not exceed 100 days and shall be limited in location.
